name: Viktori Prism'Antras
summary: Above Darkshire, Viktori Prism'Antras keeps watch on the stars. In Duskwood's gloom, he hopes a telescope will bring them into clear view.

sections.title: Eyes Upon the Heavens
sections.body: Beyond the gryphon roost, up the slope, Viktori Prism'Antras peers into Duskwood's gloom. Undead incursions, ravenous spiders, and creeping shadows surround him. Yet he looks past the suffocating canopy, hoping to build a fine telescope that brings the stars into clear focus. In the heavens, he seeks quiet refuge from the dread engulfing the hamlet.

sections.title: Gnomish Schematics and Scattered Parts
sections.body: Building a delicate telescope takes work in this cursed forest. Viktori follows blueprints from his gnomish friend, Cog Glitzspinner. He asks passersby to find rare materials for crafting lenses and mechanical housings. Finely cut glass and metal lenses lie scattered across perilous ground.

faq.answer: Viktori is an eccentric human stargazer in Darkshire. While political and supernatural threats face the town, he devotes himself to building a telescope to study the stars.

faq.q: Where can I find Viktori in Darkshire?
faq.answer: Viktori lives in a small wooden hut up the hill, just past the Darkshire gryphon master and to the right as you climb the path.

faq.q: What is Viktori trying to build?
faq.answer: Viktori is building an astronomical telescope from blueprints by his gnomish colleague Cog Glitzspinner. It needs several specialized lenses and components.

faq.q: Why is he studying the stars from Duskwood?
faq.answer: Viktori is consumed by curiosity about the heavens despite Duskwood's darkness and terror. Studying the night sky gives him an intellectual refuge from the decaying land around him.

faq.q: Who designed the plans for Viktori's telescope?
faq.answer: Cog Glitzspinner, Viktori's inventive gnome acquaintance, designed the telescope blueprints.
No. Viktori is a civilian scholar, not a warrior. He leaves Darkshire's defense to Commander Althea Ebonlocke and the Night Watch, devoting his energies to his astronomical work.

angles.text: Tinkers will appreciate Viktori's project. His precision-built viewing instrument depends on sophisticated gnomish schematics.
Viktori's project depends on Cog Glitzspinner's ingenuity. It shows how far gnomish engineering reaches, even in desolate human towns.
As an Alliance townsman, you can help Viktori pursue a rare, peaceful interest amid Darkshire's pervasive tragedy.
